messages.content: Help me generate introspection information for a class `NodeClass` representing a node in a Truffle DSL processor, and specify that the introspection is not inlined?

function.name: FlatNodeGenFactory_generateIntrospectionInfo
function.description: Generates introspection information for a given class representing a node in the Truffle DSL processor. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

clazz.description: The class element representing the node for which introspection information is to be generated. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

inlined.description: Indicates whether the introspection is inlined. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.
